result.prior_version_note: Before February 2, 2026, landlords could add an extra percentage increase for utilities on top of the allowable annual increase. They could also take a 10% increase when an additional dependent joined the tenancy. The documents imply both add-ons only by stating they are no longer permitted from that date. Separately, rent increases on RSO units were prohibited from March 30, 2020 through January 31, 2024. The RSO's original effective date is not stated in the documents.
